preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
All characters in the string must be lowercase.

postconditions.description: The output must be a list containing two strings.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(rv, str) for rv in return_value)
postconditions.description: Both elements in the output list must be strings.

postconditions.expression: all(rv[i] == s[i].upper() if i % 2 == 0 else rv[i] == s[i].lower() for i in range(len(s)) for rv in return_value)
postconditions.description: The first string in the output list must have uppercase letters at even indexes and lowercase letters at odd indexes, and vice versa for the second string.
